assuranceCeiling.rationale: Tenant-scoped SQL authorization in SECURITY DEFINER and browser RLS can leak staff data or break Team Chat after migrations; require negative/positive state matrices, SQL syntax and real target proof.

acceptanceCriteria: 0056 SQL is full unchanged canonical 20260908031000 body with correct SHA256 and after 0055.
Both secret routing tables have explicit revoke all from service_role and later CRUD-only grants without DDL.
Existing 0054 RLS and anon/authenticated table revokes remain intact; no direct browser route token grants are created.
Composite thread-instance FK index exists with same column order (thread_id,instance_id).
Customer baseline guard PASS with 57 files, snapshot-reviewed and old proof hash null, focused and TypeScript tests PASS.
No source tests mistaken for actual Postgres effective role/GRANT/DDL, or full Office/Pro capability closure.
invariants: Routing reply_token remains confidential to service-side data operations.
service_role is not explicitly granted TRUNCATE, REFERENCES or TRIGGER by F9.
FK index uses thread_id before instance_id, preserving canonical optimization.
No direct anon/authenticated read or write GRANT to Office mailbox and reply route tables.
Existing 0001–0055 SQL is immutable; same canonical SQL body is source of truth.
forbiddenStates: A customer browser reads reply_token through a new F9 grant.
F9 omits REVOKE and leaves service_role grant all in source.
Index swaps instance_id and thread_id, defeating intended FK access path.
Proof manifest marks ready despite no new actual Fresh Install.
Occupied staging or production SQL is mutated by source migration checks.

failureModes: A source copy retains GRANT ALL while omitting REVOKE ALL to service_role.
An ACL inherited through PUBLIC or owner means effective service privileges differ despite direct grants.
Anonymous Data API access accidentally added to secret routing table.
Composite route FK index missing or reversed.
DDL applied before tables from 0054 exist.
F9 SQL order executes GRANT before REVOKE, leaving privileges absent or broad.
Existing index name collides with different definition on occupied target.
Canonical source hash drifts or SQL lines truncated.
Later Office/Pro engine marked DONE despite missing upstream RPC chain.

specialistReviews.finding: Direct REVOKE service_role does not establish effective ACL under PostgreSQL inherited roles/table ownership or other grants.
specialistReviews.resolution: Source proof only and block release pending disposable PostgreSQL has_table_privilege and anon/authenticated negative tests.

specialistReviews.finding: Index on thread_id,instance_id must match canonical route FK and wait for 0054 table.
specialistReviews.resolution: Retain exact source and assert 0054/0055 ordered prerequisites and intended index.

specialistReviews.finding: Database security privilege release is high risk and constrained to one subsystem.
specialistReviews.resolution: Only 0056 SQL, manifest and neutral test with exact-parent risk 5/5; no GitHub push/Preview.

specialistReviews.finding: Staging is not a disposable Fresh Install target and may carry different ACLs and indexes.
specialistReviews.resolution: No SQL target write, preserve reviewed state and require ledger/role preflight before any rollout.

challenge.scenario: A service_role worker tries to truncate office_mailboxes while processing inbound mail because its former grant was ALL.
challenge.finding: Overbroad table privileges would allow destructive DDL-like operations unnecessary for ingestion.
challenge.resolution: Apply canonical REVOKE ALL followed only by select,insert,update,delete on office_mailboxes, and later prove effective TRUNCATE denied.

challenge.scenario: A worker calls REFERENCES or TRIGGER operation on office_thread_email_routes after the grant repair.
challenge.finding: An unintended privilege may persist despite CRUD-only expectations and change routing enforcement.
challenge.resolution: Preserve exact canonical service_role revoke/regrant for routes; later inspect effective PostgreSQL grants.

challenge.scenario: An authenticated browser attempts selecting reply_token from office_thread_email_routes.
challenge.finding: A secret reply address routing token could be leaked if a role grant or RLS policy is broadened.
challenge.resolution: Assert no new browser grants in 0056 and preserve 0054 RLS + anon/authenticated revokes; require DB negative actor test.

challenge.scenario: The composite FK causes deletes from office_threads to scan routes without a matching leading thread_id index.
challenge.finding: Tenant data deletion may degrade due to swapped index columns despite both appearing in a name.

challenge.scenario: The index already exists on occupied target with same name but incompatible definition.
challenge.finding: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS may silently skip a wrong index and performance proof would be misleading.
challenge.resolution: Keep source unchanged, mandate later real pg_indexes definition reconciliation and do not claim target readiness.

challenge.scenario: A new Fresh Install runs 0056 before creating the office_mailboxes table in 0054.
challenge.finding: REVOKE/GRANT and CREATE INDEX statements fail with missing relation during bootstrap.
challenge.resolution: Assert 0054 and 0055 come before 0056 in ordered customer baseline and require eventual clean replay.

challenge.scenario: PUBLIC or inherited role grants access to mailbox despite direct service_role restriction.
challenge.finding: Source checks can report least privilege while effective PostgreSQL privilege remains broader.
challenge.resolution: Keep release partial, require real has_table_privilege checks for PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role.

challenge.scenario: A new 0056 baseline is marked ready based only on its source hash.
challenge.finding: CI would falsely certify real Office provider/RPC and strict Pro subscription behavior while later dependencies are absent.
challenge.resolution: Keep manifest snapshot-reviewed with freshInstallProofRequired true and no old proof hash until full target acceptance.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The reviewed customer baseline 0054 introduces service-only Office mailbox and secret reply-token route tables, and 0055 normalizes their mailbox identity. Canonical production source 20260908031000 immediately follows to revoke all service_role privileges and regrant only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE while creating an index in thread_id,instance_id order for the composite FK. Without append-only 0056, Fresh Install diverges from canonical least-privilege SQL, but source equality alone cannot demonstrate effective inherited PostgreSQL privileges.

Both office_mailboxes and office_thread_email_routes lose direct service_role ALL grants and regain only four CRUD grants, with no added anon/authenticated permissions.
Composite office_thread_email_routes_thread_instance_idx index covers (thread_id,instance_id) matching FK checks/deletes.
